skills.name: dart-idioms
skills.description: Applies software design idiomatically in Dart and Flutter — immutable models with final/const and copyWith, sealed classes with pattern matching, mixins, extension methods, null safety, async and streams, Effective Dart naming. Use when writing Dart or Flutter code, or asked "how do I model this in Dart", "sealed class", "mixin or inheritance", or "OOP in Dart".
